requirement.value: The Sharpshooter and/or Prizefighter (Weaponmaster) Class — acquired, not mastered, as printed

system.description: With a transforming custom weapon equipped whose forms are one melee and one ranged: use Bone Crusher and Counterattack with its ranged form, and Crossfire and Warning Shot with its melee form — never Bone Crusher and Warning Shot on the same attack. After you use Bone Crusher or Warning Shot with a melee weapon, each enemy hit becomes ruptured until the end of the scene; when a ruptured enemy takes damage from anything other than a melee attack, they suffer 5 extra damage and stop being ruptured. Ruptured is a primed condition on the Anatomist's reeling precedent — not a seventh status, so no cleanse removes it, and it clears the moment it pays. It is private to this heroic: it never shares a trigger or a payout with reeling or broken. Requires the class only, not mastery, as printed: the source says "even if you have not mastered them" and means it.
